CheckTitle: OAuth clients have no wildcard sign-in redirect URIs
Description: Okta OAuth and OIDC clients are evaluated for sign-in redirect URIs whose host contains a wildcard label.
Risk: Wildcard redirect hosts can send authorization codes or tokens to unintended or attacker-controlled subdomains if DNS or app ownership changes.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Applications > Applications.
2. Open the affected OIDC app integration and review General Settings > Login.
3. Remove wildcard sign-in redirect URIs and add exact HTTPS callback URIs for each approved environment.
4. Disable wildcard redirect support for the app unless a documented exception is approved.
5. Test the authorization-code flow after updating the redirect URI allowlist.

Recommendation.Text: Replace wildcard OIDC sign-in redirect URIs with exact HTTPS redirect URIs controlled by the application owner.

Notes: Requires okta.clients.read. This check intentionally has no allowlist unless a standard Prowler mutelist is used.
